Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
A Lasombra puts Political Struggle on
a. Ayo Igoli, who is a Kholo (and the same player controls another titled vampires)
b. Gerald Windham (while there are 3 titled vampires controlled not by the same player)
c. Dmitra (while the same player controls Orlando Oriundus)

When that vampire goes to torpor, the Lasombra who played Political Struggle in the first place gains
a. four votes.
b. three votes.
c. three votes; not six since Orlando's multiplier ability only triggers during a referendum).

Correct?

> Name: Political Struggle
> [Sabbat:R, SW:R/PL, Third:R]
> Cardtype: Action
> Clan: Lasombra
> +1 stealth action.
> Put this card on a ready vampire controlled by another Methuselah. The acting vampire may enter combat with the vampire with this card as a +1 stealth  action. If the vampire with this card is burned or sent into torpor, this card is burned and the acting vampire gains X votes, where X is the number of non-contested votes the vampire with this card has.
> Artist: Patrick Kochakji
>

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: Ayo gets 2 votes from Kholo, another from herself being titled, and the fourth from the other titled vampire.
